# Logistics 0.2.1-beta.2

- Promotes the verified 0.2.1 alpha fixes to beta, including a native Transfers screen, transfer history and resumable downloads.
- Simplifies mobile File Browser actions, moves saved documents under Libraries, and improves the file tiles and Settings Back transition.
- Improves AirPlay recovery after wake and resolves the HEVC segment error seen in the reported Apple TV session.
- Select several files with the leading circles, then Move, Archive or Delete them together. On iOS, hold over a folder to open it during a drag.
- iOS video puts chapter skips beside the timeline, and notebook cutouts wait for the PDF background before copying.
- The Transfers icon next to Server shows live MB/s and per-file progress. Review Push and Pull changes in native controls, with the option to skip the preview.
- New document and New folder are in the Notes Library sidebar. File Browser details open over the current folder.
- Mobile tiles center the image and two-line filename. Press and hold for file actions. Reader menus focus on the open document.
- Interrupted downloads can resume when an app update moves their verified destination. Discard can clear the saved entry if the destination is unavailable.
- Resumable downloads keep a native stream open per file and still save verified checkpoints.
